user.title: Tuya SL-CE Videolock
user.description:
Connect the SL-CE smart videolock via Tuya Cloud.

**Where to find the values**
1. Open your [Tuya Cloud project]({tuya_project_url}) (Overview / Basic Configuration).
2. Copy **Access ID** and **Access Secret** from the project credentials.
3. Open **Devices**, pick the lock, and copy the **Device ID**.
4. Choose the **region** that matches the project data center (this project uses **AZ / Americas**).

Also enable on the same project: *IoT Core*, *Smart Lock Open Service*, and *IoT Video Live Stream*.

Default device (RuGiu): `{device_hint}`

data_description.access_id: Client ID / Access ID from the Cloud project overview.
data_description.device_id: Tuya device id of the SL-CE lock (Cloud → Devices).
data_description.region: Must match the project data center (AZ → Americas / US).
